original_test_intent: Verify correctable GMI3 handling independently at the approved IOD and CCD injection locations, proving that the selected physical link reports the expected corrected event within an authoritative interval and returns to healthy operation.
original_method: Map every intended physical GMI link from `--listgmilinks`; preserve the exact BIOS/HDT/tool/CPU/firmware/OS baseline; obtain approval for CE flag semantics, IOD/CCD targets and one-event limits; inject one mapped IOD CE and one mapped CCD CE as separately controlled checkpoints; correlate each complete transcript with topology-specific MCA/APEI or Windows WHEA evidence, applicable BMC/UEFI records and link health; then close the injector and restore all BIOS/HDT state.
manual_activity: A qualified FAE provisions the licensed AMD tool and HDT, approves BIOS deviations and the physical GMI topology, performs separately bounded IOD and CCD CE injections, supervises recovery and restores the platform. The agent only validates and collects read-only evidence.
required_inputs: CPU/platform/GMI topology mapping from enumerated link identifiers to physical IOD and CCD resources
AMD RAS Error Injection Tool version/hash/license and exact AMD RAS specification revision
Approved meaning of linktraffic 1 and errortype 0 plus one-event/count behavior
Authoritative per-location timeout and corrected-event register/MCA/APEI/WHEA signature
Ubuntu/RHEL dmesg versus Windows WHEA evidence path and applicable BMC/UEFI expectations
BIOS FFE-versus-default-FF5 rationale, original values, HDT closeout, abort and recovery/restoration plan
safety_requirements: Use an isolated non-production SUT with independent console, backup and recovery
Map the enumerated topology; never assume link 0 is the intended link on every platform
Preserve existing host and management logs rather than clearing away unrelated evidence
Inject only the approved single CE at one location at a time and stop on wrong target, UCE/fatal escalation, storm, reset, hang or link degradation
No automatic retry; close the injector and restore BIOS threshold, sync-flood and HDT state
agent_execution_scope: Verify package provenance, platform identity, topology map, approved parameters and evidence oracle
Collect read-only pre/post link health, full tool transcript, OS corrected-event data and applicable BMC/UEFI evidence
Do not download or operate an unapproved injector, unlock HDT, change BIOS, select a link/location, inject, reset/retry, recover automatically or decide PASS/FAIL
engineer_actions: Approve exact IOD/CCD-to-link mapping and whether all enumerated links or one selected link satisfy Coverage
Approve tool/spec versions and linktraffic/errortype semantics
Define per-location timeout and Linux/Windows evidence oracle
Approve BIOS deviations, aborts, recovery, restoration and final verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Generic GMI/XGMI grep and SEL tail can support triage but cannot attribute a CE to the commanded IOD or CCD location, and dmesg is unavailable on the listed Windows path.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Run `--listgmilinks`, bind an engineer-approved physical link ID, then execute the literal IOD and CCD CE commands as separate one-shot checkpoints with full stdout/stderr/exit/timestamps and topology-specific corrected-error evidence.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Both error locations, linktraffic 1, errortype 0, four BIOS controls, supported OS choices and 20/10-minute estimates are preserved; link 0 and timeout are not treated as universal without approval.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use the enumerated physical topology to run one controlled IOD CE and one controlled CCD CE, with deterministic location-specific tool, OS and link-health evidence plus complete rollback.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds an authoritative topology binding, separate checkpoint evidence, OS-specific oracle, explicit timeout, package provenance, one-shot aborts and state restoration.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A tool PASS or generic corrected log does not prove both IOD and CCD coverage, and fixed link 0 can target the wrong resource after enumeration.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Incorrect topology or injector semantics can convert the intended CE into fabric instability, an uncorrectable event, sync flood, reset or lost management access.

project_override_considerations: If the project intentionally qualifies only link 0, the platform recipe must document its physical IOD/CCD mapping and why other enumerated links are out of scope. Linux and Windows evidence must remain OS-specific rather than requiring dmesg universally.
expected_evidence: Tool/spec version/hash/license, `--listgmilinks` output and approved physical mapping
BIOS/HDT before, approved delta and restored values
Separate IOD and CCD command transcripts with parameters, timestamps, exit status and tool PASS
Per-location corrected MCA/APEI or WHEA signature within the approved timeout and applicable BMC/UEFI correlation
Stable link/device health, no UCE/fatal escalation, injector closeout, restoration and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source enumerates GMI links but then fixes both injections to link 0 without a mapping or coverage rule. Its timeout is undefined, and Windows 2022 is listed while Criteria requires dmesg. The Criteria also lacks distinct IOD-versus-CCD evidence, so a single generic corrected event could falsely satisfy both checkpoints.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The correctable GMI3 intent and both location commands are identifiable. Engineering can supply topology, package semantics, timeout and OS-specific evidence, so static review completes while execution remains gated.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Reliability row 38 Wistron-System RAS-00758-V003: approve CPU/platform GMI link-to-IOD/CCD topology and whether link 0 or all enumerated links are required; AMD tool/spec version/hash/license and linktraffic=1/errortype=0 semantics; separate IOD/CCD CE signatures and timeout for Linux MCA/APEI/dmesg versus Windows WHEA; applicable BMC/UEFI evidence, BIOS FFE deviation, one-shot aborts, recovery and complete BIOS/HDT restoration.

review_improvement: Prevents a hardcoded link and one generic corrected log from standing in for two physical GMI3 checkpoints, while making timeout, OS evidence and restoration measurable.
independent_technical_reasoning: `--listgmilinks` exists to discover topology; immediately forcing link 0 is only defensible when a project map proves that identifier represents the intended fabric on this CPU and firmware. IOD and CCD locations exercise different origins, so each needs its own transcript and attributable corrected-event signature. An unspecified timeout makes the stated PASS/FAIL boundary non-reproducible, and dmesg cannot serve as the Windows oracle. Because a wrong target or flag can escalate fabric severity, package semantics, one-shot control and rollback are prerequisites rather than optional documentation.
